Authentic Nigerian Flavours, Prepared with Care

We understand the longing for the rich, authentic taste of home. But finding clean, stone-free, and well-processed local ingredients shouldn't be a challenge.

Taste of Home Foods was born out of a desire to provide premium Nigerian pantry staples that you can trust. We meticulously sort, clean, and process our spices and soup ingredients under the strictest hygienic conditions.

No sand. No preservatives. Just the pure, unadulterated flavour of home, securely packaged for your family's table.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you ship internationally?
Yes, we ship to the UK, USA, and Canada. Delivery times vary by location, but we ensure all products are securely packaged for international transit.
Are there any preservatives in your products?
No, all Taste of Home Foods are 100% natural with zero preservatives, chemicals, or artificial additives.
How long do the spices stay fresh?
When stored in a cool, dry place, our spices maintain their premium flavour and aroma for up to 12 months.
How do I place an order?
Simply click the "Order Now" button on any product to connect with us on WhatsApp, or use the general WhatsApp button to send us your list.
Are the soup ingredients stone-free?
Absolutely. Our Egusi and Ogbono are meticulously cleaned, picked, and finely ground to ensure a 100% stone-free, smooth texture.
Do you deliver within Nigeria?
Yes! We deliver nationwide across Nigeria. Contact us via WhatsApp to confirm delivery rates and timelines to your location.
